versions.content: A Deferrable Server requires its own priority level If a Task has OsTaskTimingProtectionDeferrableServer enabled (is TRUE ), then on the same core there shall be no other Task(s) configured which use the same Os- TaskPriority . Otherwise the consistency check shall issue an error.
